run_batch_agent: run batch agent processing across multiple prompts from a JSONL dataset with parallel workers
resume_batch_run: resume an interrupted batch agent run from checkpoint by scanning completed prompts by content
list_toolset_distributions: list available toolset distributions for the agent batch runner
build_batch_runner: build a BatchRunner instance to process prompts with configurable model, distribution, and worker count
aggregate_tool_statistics: aggregate tool usage statistics across all batch runs with success and failure rates
